intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (2) Nanshan Luohe mountain pass (40.8 k

story: A 5-rider break formed early. The break split on the first climb, distancing Munk and Konychev. Shortly after, the break reunited on the first KOM. However, just before the summit of the second KOM, severe weather conditions forced the stage to be cancelled. Riders descended or took team cars to the lakeside, where transfer buses awaited to transport all competitors.
